name: beadrelief
description: Turn any image into an editable, multicolor 3MF bead relief — locally in your browser.

scripts.build: tsc && node scripts/clean-dist.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/post-build.cjs && node scripts/write-html.cjs
scripts.sample: npm run build && node scripts/generate-sample.mjs && node scripts/generate-layered-sample.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/generate-sample.mjs && node scripts/generate-layered-sample.mjs
